name: Campus App
summary: A single app for timetables, notices, room availability and event registration — replacing four noticeboards and a WhatsApp group.

name: Attendance System
summary: QR and geofence-backed attendance with a faculty dashboard, built to survive a lecture hall of two hundred students.

name: AI Resume Builder
summary: Turns a project history into a targeted, ATS-readable resume — and explains every edit it makes rather than rewriting silently.

name: Portfolio Generator
summary: Point it at a GitHub profile and it produces a deployable portfolio site with real project pages, not a template with placeholder text.

name: Malware Detector
summary: Static and behavioural triage of suspicious binaries in an isolated sandbox, producing an indicator report a human can act on.

name: Expense Tracker
summary: Shared expense tracking for hostel floors and event budgets, with settlement maths that actually closes to zero.
